post.summary: Intentional error for end-to-end jobs chain probe
post.description: Background maintenance probe: always returns HTTP 500 with `X-Jobs-Retry: never` so the job goes `dead` immediately (no retry storm) and is visible in the jobs admin UI. Invoked by the `testCronError` cron schedule (disabled outside deliberate verification) and manually by site admins. Empty body — no client fields.

schema.description: Empty JSON object. No client fields; the response is unconditional.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

403.description: Forbidden - caller is not a site admin.

500.description: Intentional failure for chain verification. Always includes `X-Jobs-Retry: never` so the queue marks the job `dead` without retries.

X-Jobs-Retry.description: Jobs runtime override. Always `never` for this operation — terminal even though the status is 5xx.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.

session.name: ory_kratos_session
session.description: Signed-in SAF user (Kratos browser session; internal job calls present the same identity via a signed assertion, which is not modeled here). Scopes: `email-verified`, `mfa`, `site-admin` (implies email-verified + mfa).
